title: Ships loiter near subsea cables following Iran's warnings
excerpt: Vessels have been spotted lingering near subsea cables after Iran issued threats over potential US military escalation.
body_html:
Vessels have been observed lingering near critical subsea cables following warnings from Iran regarding potential United States military strikes.

According to reports, Iranian threats specifically target undersea internet and communication lines should the US escalate military actions again.

The presence of ships near these vital infrastructure routes has raised concerns, though specific details regarding potential disruptions or the identities of the lingering vessels remain limited.
